recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Make future wording changes for these population codes in UTG/THO unless a later decision requires changing active Measure, MeasureReport, or Quality Reporting source text in core.
issue_request: FHIR-26655 was Published with Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. CQI chose not to create new numerator-inclusion, denominator-inclusion, or measure-population-inclusion codes; instead it requested clarification of the existing numerator and denominator MeasurePopulation definitions as inclusion criteria and noted no Measure Population definition update was needed at that time.
initial_application: No FHIR-core commit explicitly mentions FHIR-26655. The application path was UTG: UP-68 is Proposal Implemented, links FHIR-26655, and modified the THO-owned CodeSystem/measure-population definitions.
additional_context: Vocabulary minutes from May 2020 confirm the change needed to proceed through UTG because the measure-population code system had moved there. Later UP-571 further clarified the same THO terms so numerator, denominator, and measure-population are explicit starting inclusion criteria. Current THO 6.5.0 contains those definitions, while active Measure and MeasureReport source files bind to the THO value set rather than carrying local definitions.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. Current core Measure and MeasureReport bindings are correct, active Quality Reporting narrative already uses inclusion/exclusion wording, and the stale old definitions found in ResearchDefinition/history material are outside the active Measure/MeasureReport build scope.
